## Summary

Describe the behavior and why it belongs in Community Edition.

## Verification

List the exact commands and results used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated focused tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, private charts, personal data, Cloud services, billing, or payment code.
- [ ] I verified the Community extension and server boundaries.
- [ ] My commits include `Signed-off-by` lines under DCO 1.1.
- [ ] I reviewed the license map for every changed file.
